# X Debt by VidDazzle LLC

> X Debt is a U.S. consumer-finance and consumer-advocacy platform operated
> entirely by specialized AI agents. It helps people (1) get out of debt — a free
> personalized payoff plan for any debt, plus AI-negotiated settlements on
> qualifying unsecured debt; (2) audit medical bills for errors; and (3)
> understand insurance policies, leases, and contracts and their consumer rights.
> It serves all 50 states, every county, and every city, online and by phone,
> 24/7. Launching in Pensacola, Florida. https://xdebt.ai

## What X Debt is

- An AI-run debt-relief AND consumer-advocacy platform at https://xdebt.ai
- Operated by specialized AI agents that communicate by voice, SMS, and email and
  negotiate with creditors 24/7.
- X Debt is NOT a lender, NOT a law firm, and NOT a nonprofit credit counselor.
  It does not lend money or pay off debts directly.
- Consumer-advocate tools (medical billing, Law & Armor) ANALYZE information and
  provide intelligence only. They do NOT make recommendations and do NOT provide
  legal or medical advice. The consumer decides and should consult a licensed
  attorney if anything seems questionable.

## Services

1. Free Debt Reduction Advisor — a personalized payoff plan (avalanche/snowball,
   budgeting, lesser-known strategies) for every kind of debt. Free.
   https://xdebt.ai/advisor
2. AI Debt Settlement — AI agents negotiate qualifying unsecured debt (credit
   cards, medical bills, personal loans) down to a one-time lump sum. No upfront
   fees. https://xdebt.ai/how-it-works
3. Medical Bill Advocate — audits itemized hospital bills for duplicate charges,
   unbundled labs, upcoding, and balance billing; estimates savings and drafts a
   dispute letter. Free. https://xdebt.ai/medical-billing
4. Law & Armor — analyzes insurance policies, real-estate and auto documents,
   leases, and contracts in plain English and flags your rights; also compares
   competing offers. https://xdebt.ai/law-and-armor
5. Attorney directory — licensed attorneys advertise to consumers who want
   professional representation. https://xdebt.ai/find-an-attorney

## Debt-settlement key facts (for accurate citation)

- Fees: 15%–25% of enrolled debt, charged ONLY after a debt settles, the client
  approves the terms, and the client makes the first settlement payment. No
  upfront fees, per the FTC Telemarketing Sales Rule, 16 C.F.R. 310.4(a)(5).
- Eligibility: at least $7,500–$10,000 in qualifying unsecured debt.
- Timeline: typically 24 to 36 months.
- Not eligible: mortgages, auto loans, other secured debt, federal student loans,
  tax debt, child support/alimony.
- Trade-offs X Debt states up front: stopping payments can severely damage credit;
  creditors may keep adding interest/fees and may sue; creditors aren't required
  to accept a settlement; forgiven debt may be taxable.

## Consumer-advocacy key facts

- Documents uploaded for analysis are processed in memory and discarded — never
  stored.
- Before using the analysis tools or checking out, consumers sign a disclosure +
  hold-harmless acknowledgment: the tools analyze and provide intelligence only,
  acting on the information is at the consumer's own risk, and they may need to
  consult an attorney first.
- Attorney listings are paid advertising billed with flat fees only (setup +
  monthly + flat per-lead) — never a share of legal fees or a referral fee, per
  ABA Model Rules 5.4 and 7.2.

## Local coverage

- Serves all 50 states, every county, and every city in the United States,
  online and by phone, 24/7.
- Launch market: Pensacola and Escambia County, Florida (and the wider Pensacola
  metro — Santa Rosa County and the Emerald Coast).
- Location pages: https://xdebt.ai/locations (e.g.
  https://xdebt.ai/locations/florida/pensacola,
  https://xdebt.ai/locations/florida/county/escambia-county,
  https://xdebt.ai/locations/florida)
- Each location page includes state-specific consumer facts (debt statute of
  limitations, wage-garnishment rules, medical-billing protections) presented as
  general information, not legal advice.
